title: Nidoran♀ Uses Whiskers Instead of Fighting Predators
premise: While foraging, Nidoran♀ checks wind direction with her whiskers and stays downwind of predators.
audiencePromise: Reveal why Nidoran♀ checks the wind before predators can become a threat.
openLoop: Why use whiskers when Nidoran♀ already has a venomous horn?
payoff: Her quiet defense is not a fight. It is reading wind direction and staying downwind.
engagementQuestion: Trust wind direction, or rely on her venomous horn?

voice.instructions: Fast, hushed, and alert. Build tension on predator words, then slow slightly for the wind reveal. Keep every line crisp and conversational.
